title: Nutty Bitter Kenyan Meat Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Kenyan stew featuring bitter notes and chewy texture, perfect for special occasions. This dish combines garlic, ferment-kimchi, and nutty elements for a unique taste experience.
instructions: Heat the peanut oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the beef chunks and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped bitter leaf, ferment-kimchi, salt, and black pepper, stirring well to combine.
Pour in the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
